# HUCAS Swimming Class

> Les renang untuk anak (4+), dewasa, dan private 1-on-1 di Denpasar, Bali. Swimming lessons for kids, adults and private classes in Denpasar, Bali. Slogan: Everyone Can Swim.

Coach: Arya Singa (Swim Coach, teaching since 2021)

## Locations
- Augi Sport Center, Renon: https://lesrenanghucas.com/les-renang-renon/

- Amartha Regist, Padang Sambian: https://lesrenanghucas.com/les-renang-padang-sambian/

## Prices (IDR, excl. pool ticket)
- Adult Group Class: 1x Rp 140K, 4x Rp 500K, 8x Rp 800K, 16x Rp 1.700K
- Kids Group Class: 4x Rp 300K, 8x Rp 350K, 12x Rp 400K
- Private 1-on-1: 1x Rp 300K, 4x Rp 800K, 8x Rp 1.500K, 16x Rp 2.900K
